title: Direct supervision of Massachusetts pharmacy interns
rule_summary: A Massachusetts pharmacy intern works under the direct supervision of a registered pharmacist preceptor.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply intern supervision requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Direct supervision of Massachusetts pharmacy interns

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing intern supervision with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
